title: Cloudflare Provider Architecture
context: Cloudflare Workers AI uses OpenAI-compatible API. Account ID embedded in URL path. Base URL pattern: https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/ai. Final URL hit: https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{id}/ai/v1/chat/completions.

decisions.question: How to add cloudflare provider?
decisions.answer: add-provider --type cloudflare AND setup --provider cloudflare both call createPredefinedModels() for 9 models. No discover.

decisions.question: How to store account_id?
decisions.answer: account_id as column on providers table (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''). Set at creation only. Immutable via update.

consequences: Base URL pattern + double-path trap documented
